prompts.title: Net debt
prompts.prompt: Net debt on the latest balance sheet date: all debt minus cash and cash equivalents.

prompts.title: Free cash flow
prompts.prompt: Free cash flow for the latest period the filing reports: net cash from operating activities minus capital spending on property and equipment.

prompts.title: Gross margin check
prompts.prompt: Gross margin check for the latest period the filing reports: recompute gross margin from revenue and cost of revenue, and compare it with the printed gross margin.

prompts.title: Capex intensity
prompts.prompt: Capex intensity for the latest period the filing reports: capital spending on property and equipment as a share of revenue.

prompts.title: Equity value from an enterprise value
prompts.prompt: Equity value from an enterprise value the person enters, on the latest balance sheet date: enterprise value minus all debt plus cash and cash equivalents.
